# bot.mubx.dev

> MUBXBot: a free, unofficial web assistant for Al Hussein Technical University (HTU) students — instructor emails, office hours, office locations and department search.

MUBXBot answers questions about HTU faculty using public directory data, with typo-tolerant fuzzy search. It is an independent, student-built project by MUBX (https://mubx.dev), founded by Omar Mubaidin. It is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by HTU.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bot.mubx.dev/): ask MUBXBot — “what Dr. Ahmed” (email), “when Dr. Ahmed” (office hours), “where Dr. Ahmed” (office location), or search by department
- [FAQ](https://bot.mubx.dev/faq): common questions about MUBXBot
- [Contribute](https://bot.mubx.dev/contribute): help improve the instructor directory
- [For AI assistants](https://bot.mubx.dev/for-ai): entity facts, capabilities and citation rules

## MUBX network

- [mubx.dev](https://mubx.dev): MUBX, the web engineering studio behind MUBXBot
- [ai.mubx.dev](https://ai.mubx.dev): MUBXAI — free GPA calculator and academic tracker for HTU students
- [me.mubx.dev](https://me.mubx.dev): Omar Mubaidin's personal portfolio
